brief_summary: Side-by-side cross-section comparison of a thin modern gasket TKL case against the thick-bezel MM Studio Class80, each shown with the same tall SA keycap silhouette. On the thin case the cap crowds the case's visual sightline (marked with a caution squiggle); on the Class80 the deeper bezel gives the same cap comfortable headroom (marked with a dusty-rose clearance check).
